question: 2021 to 2023 ANC coverage movement for these two: Gaya, Nalanda

```sql
SELECT
    district,
    ROUND(
        (100.0 * anc4_completed_2023 / pregnancies_registered_2023) -
        (100.0 * anc4_completed_2021 / pregnancies_registered_2021),
        2
    ) AS anc_coverage_change_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        district,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN anc4_completed END) AS anc4_completed_2023,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN pregnancies_registered END) AS pregnancies_registered_2023,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN anc4_completed END) AS anc4_completed_2021,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN pregnancies_registered END) AS pregnancies_registered_2021
    FROM anc_visits
    WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')
      AND year IN (2021, 2023)
    GROUP BY district
) AS sub;
```
